title: Ohio contractor wins appeal over $270,000 property after county challenges its commercial use
summary_full: Jackson & Jackson, LLC is challenging Butler County's zoning rules that prevent it from operating its business. The Ohio Court of Appeals has restored two of its claims regarding property rights and compensation. In November 2021, the company purchased a property with a history of commercial use for $270,000. The Lower court initially dismissed all three claims, leading to the appeal.
